title: Cops Find Decapitated Girl in Garage Before Halloween
description:
Bodycam shows New Mexico cops making a horrifying discovery two days before Halloween. Santa Fe officers found Grace Jennings dead and nearly decapitated in a garage. Isaac Apodaca, who initially called 911 and lives on the property, blamed Kiara McCulley, but his story quickly unraveled when detectives searched his phone. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

event_summary.short: Police in Santa Fe, NM discover the body of 21-year-old Grace Jennings, nearly decapitated, in a garage. Two suspects, Isaac Apodaca and Kiara McCulley, are charged with murder and conspiracy. Kiara pleads guilty and will serve 30 years; Isaac's trial is pending.
